# How much of your bonus do you actually keep?

> Free bonus calculator: what a bonus pays after the 22% federal supplemental withholding, Social Security, Medicare and state tax, whether you owe or get a refund at filing, and the gross-up an employer needs to pay a bonus net. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
